item.title: Agent Memory
item.description:
Motivation:

  • Context window is limited.
  • Automatically getting relevant info would also be pretty cool.

There is an external database that stores the relevant information. It must support querying, and curating.

Some must be never forgotten, some must be forgotten.

The important/interesting thing is how curation happens.

Quite interesting to realize that evals must take into account probably a dynamic memory.

item.title: Agent Evals
item.description:
notes from this short video.

We want agents to be reliable. Reliability = Observability + Evals

Observability means we can see what agent did. What the model response was, what the tool response was.

LLM response desired properties:

  • Relevance: Answer relevance to the user’s query

  • Groundedness (relates to hallucination as well): uses the particular context provided (as opposed to the generic response)

  • Tool Sequence Accuracy: does not do wasteful tool calls, and follows correct sequence of tool calls
